problem_statement: On SMP systems the signest nested-signal test fails because signals are not delivered/reordered correctly: a signal can be lost or dispatched in parallel across CPUs, producing wrong odd/even/nested handler counts or a timeout in wait_finish(). The kernel signal-dispatch path has a race between nxsig_tcbdispatch and nxsig_deliver over tcb->sigprocmask / task_state that loses or misorders pending signals on multi-core. The test must observe that catchable signals are delivered sequentially to the intended thread with correct nested counts on SMP.
